extensions.name: user_stories
extensions.description: User-story IDs per feature (US-1xx..US-6xx), joined to docs/SRS/REQUIREMENTS.md user stories and features/details/*.json

fields.as_a: actor role (owner, landlord, tenant, renter, user)
fields.acceptance: list of testable acceptance criteria {criterion, test}

extensions.name: user_story_design
extensions.description: UX design spec per user story: screen name, layout wireframe (textual), @swal/ui components used, interaction flow, and UI states. All English.

fields.layout: textual wireframe of the screen regions

extensions.name: feature_detail_files
extensions.description: Per-feature detail: user stories with acceptance, tests (unit/integration/e2e), security, microtasks. Generated by .gitcore/scripts/generate-features.py
